Company description: GE (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

General Electric Company, trading under the ticker GE, is a globally recognized American industrial conglomerate with a legacy spanning over a century. Founded in 1892 through the merger of Edison General Electric Company and Thomson-Houston Electric Company, the firm historically operated as an industrial powerhouse, driving innovation in power generation, aviation, healthcare, and home appliances, alongside its prominent financial services arm, GE Capital. Over the past decade, the company underwent a massive strategic transformation, divesting major business segments such as healthcare and appliances to refocus its operations. This multi-year restructuring culminated in the historic completion of a planned corporate split, dividing the enterprise into independent, publicly traded entities. Today, GE officially operates as GE Aerospace, focusing on the design and manufacture of commercial and military jet engines, avionics, and electrical power systems, while its former energy portfolio operates independently as GE Vernova.
